title: EI-DDLGN: Efficient Encrypted Inference with Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks under TFHE
abstract: arXiv:2609.13636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy-preserving inference via Torus Fully Homomorphic Encryption (TFHE) provides strong protection for sensitive data in outsourced deep learning applications. However, most TFHE-compatible neural network frameworks remain based on arithmetic neural architectures, resulting in high inference latency due to programmable bootstrapping (PBS), accumulator growth, and circuit bit-width sensitivity. In this work, we investigate Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (DDLGNs) as a Boolean-native alternative for encrypted inference under TFHE. Because DDLGNs learn Boolean computations directly and discretize into fixed logic gate networks, their inference procedure is naturally aligned with TFHE's Boolean execution model and avoids arithmetic accumulation in hidden layers. translated_title: EI-DDLGN：基于TFHE的深度可微逻辑门网络高效加密推理
translated_abstract: 通过环面全同态加密（TFHE）实现的隐私保护推理，为外包深度学习应用中的敏感数据提供了强大的保护。然而，大多数与TFHE兼容的神经网络框架仍然基于算术神经架构，由于可编程自举（PBS）、累加器增长和电路位宽敏感性等问题，导致推理延迟较高。在这项工作中，我们研究了深度可微逻辑门网络（DDLGN）作为TFHE下加密推理的布尔原生替代方案。由于DDLGN直接学习布尔计算并离散化为固定的逻辑门网络，其推理过程天然与TFHE的布尔执行模型对齐，并避免了隐藏层中的算术累加。我们提出了EI-DDLGN，这是首个对基于TFHE的DDLGN推理的深入研究，并刻画了加密执行成本如何依赖于模型大小和学习到的布尔函数。
tldr: 本文提出EI-DDLGN，首次深入研究基于TFHE全同态加密的深度可微逻辑门网络推理，利用其布尔原生特性与TFHE布尔执行模型的天然契合性来避免算术累加，从而显著降低加密推理延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper presents EI-DDLGN, the first in-depth study of encrypted inference with Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks under TFHE, leveraging the Boolean-native nature of DDLGNs to naturally align with TFHE's Boolean execution model and avoid arithmetic accumulation, thereby significantly reducing encrypted inference latency.
